MRT.note: Tekavoul payments are stated but not as digital.

facts.fact: The World Bank says the project supports developing and piloting a strategy for continuous updating of Mauritania's social registry so households, including refugees, can register or update data at any time.

MRT.note: No data exchange between systems stated.
No programme management information system described.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Mauritania's social registry, updated and expanded with project support, included more than 305,000 of the poorest households as of November 2024, above its 200,000 objective.
